verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll/PEO platform, so an API-driven payroll preview with anomaly review is a fair axis to judge. The evidence only shows manual, UI-based pre-payroll checks, such as reviewing the Analytics > Custom Payroll Report and employee profiles. Nothing documents a payroll preview API, anomaly detection, or agent access, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.
